observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: Two instructors present the steps side by side in a studio setting, combining spoken explanations with counted demonstrations. They break down each step into distinct counts and repeat them multiple times for practice.

lesson_structure.note: Two instructors introduce themselves and the dance tutorial.

steps_taught.name: Paso 1
steps_taught.description: Golpe with left foot followed by 3 carretillas, repeated 15 times.

steps_taught.name: Paso 2
steps_taught.description: Sequence of 3 descansos, one preparación, and 4 deslizados atrás.

steps_taught.name: Paso 3
steps_taught.description: Two carretillas sencillas and three carretillas seguidas.

steps_taught.name: Paso 4
steps_taught.description: Similar to Paso 1 with three carretillas seguidas, repeated 14 times.

steps_taught.name: Paso 5
steps_taught.description: Cross and jalón, descross and jalón, repeated 20 times.

steps_taught.name: Paso 6
steps_taught.description: Three carretillas seguidas starting with right foot, repeated 8 times.

steps_taught.name: Paso 7
steps_taught.description: Triscados to the lateral with 3 small escunteados, repeated 11 times.

what_works: Clear numbering of steps and repetition counts
Demonstration from both instructors side by side
what_hinders: Lack of mirror-image view or alternate camera angles
Fast transitions between steps without music

quotes.text: Hoy vamos a enseñarles el baile de La Bamba.
El paso número dos es una secuencia.
La mujer hace lo que es conocido como la bendición.

evidence_segments.observation: Two instructors standing side by side in a dance studio introducing the lesson.
Instructors demonstrating footwork with small taps and steps.

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down each numbered paso into specific repetition counts with oral counts and descriptive sub-movements like descanso and preparación.
